title.from: Type Creative — blurb, script, or thumbnail attached to a Deliverable
title.to: Type Creative — signed-off file/version that can be trafficked

description.from:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress.

## Type: Creative

Blurb, script, or thumbnail. Attached to a Deliverable (or Slot). **Can fail independently of the Slot** (bad take, wrong crop, rejected angle) without skipping the placement clock until Publicist replaces it.

Useful as the copy/art attached to LandingPage, Video, ImageSet, SocialCopy, or PpcCopy.

## Out of scope

- Not the Slot
- Not the SharePayload (that is the packed, channel-ready bundle)
- No implementation from this issue
description.to:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress. Publicist accepted.

## Type: Creative

A **signed-off file/version** that can be trafficked (image, video master, thumbnail crop). Attached to a Deliverable.

**Copy is not a Creative.** Social/PPC words live on Post, AdDraft, or Deliverable `kind=SocialCopy|PpcCopy`. A Creative can fail independently of the Slot (bad crop, rejected master) without moving the placement clock until Publicist replaces it.

## Out of scope

- Not the Slot
- Not the Post (packed channel bundle)
- Not body copy, headlines, or descriptions
- No implementation from this issue
